text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: prod runtime alert — pool 'us-east-1/gpu-pool-a' latency pulse detected
Maria: Seeing same on console. p95 from 120ms -> 380ms, p99 from 300ms -> 1.8s starting ~10:05 UTC
AJ: Confirm. Spike aligns with runtime rollout `kernel-autotuner v2` at 10:03. Also increase in GPU kernel queue length
Sandeep: I rolled the autotuner. It uses a runtime heuristic that prefers fused matmul kernel for seq<=256. Maybe it's misclassifying a workload with longer activations.
Lisa: KV cache evictions spiked for tenant-42 around 10:06. Could be noisy neighbor causing more cache churn + backend batching change.
Ryan: Posting condensed flamegraph snippet from profiler:
```
83% runtime_kernel::fused_matmul
  45% attention::cuda_kernel
  20% kv_cache::evict
  18% scheduler::batch_assemble
```
AJ: Yikes. Notice `kv_cache::evict` and `batch_assemble` high — hints batching heuristic combined with cache thrash
Sandeep: Mitigations: 1) flip ff `runtime.kernel_autotune=false` 2) enable stable-kernel profile `runtime.kernel_profile=stable-v1` 3) temporarily throttle tenant-42 to reduce noisy neighbor
Maria: Can we do ff flip quickly? oncall action?
AJ: I'll flip feature flag and watch. Running: `curl -X POST https://ff.redwood/api/flags/runtime.kernel_autotune -d '{"value":false}'`
deploy-bot: feature-flag update accepted for `runtime.kernel_autotune` by AJ
AJ: Done. Also set profile to stable-v1 for pool 'gpu-pool-a'
deploy-bot: config change applied to pool 'gpu-pool-a'
Ryan: Started routing heavy requests from tenant-42 to fallback pool 'gpu-pool-b' with conservative kernel and smaller batch sizes
Maria: Monitoring: p99 trending down: 1.8s -> 900ms after FF flip + routing
Lisa: KV cache eviction rate down 70%
Sandeep: Good. We'll revert autotuner changes and push a patch to autotuner to add seq-length guard. I'll open PR.
AJ: Owner: AJ (ff flip + monitoring), Ryan (routing), Sandeep (autotuner fix), Maria (customer comms)
Maria: Posting short status to #incidents and sending note to customers on affected plans
incident-bot: Incident annotated as 'mitigated' — followups: autotuner rollback, add more conservative batching thresholds, add tenant throttling policy
Maria: Thanks team. I'll close this thread once metrics are stable for 30m
Ryan: +1
Sandeep: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/532
Maria: p99 steady ~450ms for last 10m, closing incident
incident-bot: Incident resolved — latency pulse mitigated
